感觉是同类游戏里比较差的一档了。 第一，随机性特别大，而且没有局外的永久提升手段，以及局内类似永续BUFF或者遗物之类的提升，完全随机导致build很难成型，没有成长体系导致开始玩和玩了很久之后进游戏的起始一模一样，很难爽起来。 第二，UI和界面极其简陋，简洁到简陋的界面很多时候会一脸懵逼，没有控制按键提示导致我到现在都不知道这游戏是没有类似空格等于拉摇杆的快捷操作还是他没写进手册里要我自己找，手册的BUFF解释是真的只写了一半还是我没找到翻页在哪（包括滚轮，点击，方向键，拖拉等操作都没法翻页）。 第三，不知道是游戏本身的引导有问题还是BUG特别严重。比如收集两个碎片合成加血量或者法力上限的道具，有时候收集到两个了，拉摇杆然后同屏就激发了，有时候一直同屏一直不激发，白白占着两个位置，不知道是遇到BUG卡住了还是有什么特别的激发方式，反正游戏里既没有提示，单纯的点击拖拉也没用。再比如删除图标，同类图标是重叠的就很蛋疼，同样的箭袋，一个是用完了，一个是还剩三支箭，一个是满的，就会显示你有三个箭袋，然后删图标是不允许你选的（反正我没找到怎么弄帮助手册里也没有），删除了两次，用完的和满的箭袋被删除了，说明不是按顺序来的，是随机删除。 就有很多类似的，你不知道是真的有很多恶性BUG还是UI界面的过于简陋导致的游戏困难，反正极其简陋的帮助手册是一点都没提到

简单玩了一遍所有人物，发现了许多问题，导致可玩性较低。 1、除了野蛮人外的人物天赋对于通关的帮助很小，天赋第二好用的是第四个人物，因为钱多可以买到更多的高级护甲和虚弱符文。 2、除了野蛮人外想通关，最后boss只能依靠叠满虚弱降低boss输出且有140以上的常态护甲。 3、随机的武器可玩套路非常的少，一眼就看到底，玩上几把就没有乐趣了。 4、最终boss的数值提升过于夸张了，导致没有满虚弱的情况下只有野蛮人能硬抗伤害而不死，直接让很多流派同质化：虚弱+护甲+随意武器。 5、人物的特性也似乎没有特别的与其他玩法区别开来，也可能是我玩的少没有找出合适的搭配。 对于此类选道具过关的模式 本游戏跟 最近的键盘侠和猫神牧场 相比可玩性低许多，同样是抢先体验版本，差距还是有点大的。 建议等更新多些内容后再尝试，现阶段再多观望看看。

[b]Best played with mouse Recommended buy price: 3$ Score: 5,5/10[/b]

Spin Hero is a mobile app that's been dumped on Steam as if it was a real PC game (it's not)... it's a cash grab from greedy mobile devs. This mobile app is basically a complete ripoff of Slay the Spire only with pixelcrap graphics because the mobile devs behind this weren't capable of any better. Anyway it's unfair to call it a complete ripoff, the CCG elements of Slay the Spire were also too complicated for the mobile devs, so they slapped in a nonsensical poker machine mechanic instead. You "build" a collection of elements then pull the arm on the one armed bandit, your stuff + whatever comes up builds your attack and you kill the little pixelcrap picture of an enemy. God this is so bad. From a technical perspective, as a mobile app, this doesn't meet basic minimum requirements that most PC gamers expect as standard. A choice was made to use obsolete, decades old retro pixel "art" as a substitute for contemporary PC graphics. It's unclear if this is due to lack of budget or talent, regardless, the overall visual quality of the game is extremely low as a result. There's no option to change the resolution and no useful graphics tweaks. There's no way to ensure this is running at the native resolution of your display. There's no guarantee this game will look right on any PC as a result of this hamfisted design decision. The mobile app features simple, cartoony 2D graphics, of the type you normally expect to see in low effort mobile apps. 3D graphics programming does require a degree of skill and competence and unfortunately not all developers have the budget or talent to deliver this, despite 3D graphics cards hitting the mainstream in the 1990's. Considering this is being evaluated as a PC game, having the graphics phoned in like this isn't going to result in a high quality, visually impressive game that PC gamers are used to seeing. The controls can't be customised because the game has such a dumbed down, simplified interface that it's just iPhone screen tapping stuff. The fact that the interface is this dumbed down might be seen as a problem in itself, however... this is a fairly shallow experience if you're the kind of gamer that likes to play games with deep, rich control schemes and interaction. You'll get none of that here. Because this is a mobile app, it carries a number of deliberate design deficiencies. Compromises were made to cater to the iPhones that the mobile app was designed for. These are unfortunate handicaps and limitations that PC gamers shouldn't be forced to accept, but it's evident that PC was an afterthought for the iPhone developers who are to blame for this. The mobile app is deficient as a result of these choices, and would have been so much better without the handicaps that designing games for mobile phones forces upon a game. Once more, mobile devs have made gaming worse for everyone. I didn't spend thousands on building a gaming rig just so I could pretend it's an iPhone. These technical defects push this mobile app below acceptable standards for any modern PC game. So, should you buy this mobile app? Is this one of the best of the 130,000+ games on Steam? Once more we see greedy mobile devs trying to scam PC gamers. On Steam, this is $8 USD, on app stores, it's $6. Mobile devs must learn PC gamers are not here to be gouged, and can't be expected to pay a <<<<<<<<<<< PRICE DIFFF >>>>>>>> for an already overpriced mobile app just because it's been lazily dumped on Steam. This is unacceptable disrespect for PC gamers. Because this is a mobile app, is priced to insult and gouge PC gamers, and because of the other defects, it's impossible to recommend. Just who do they think we are? For comparison, the $8 asking price for this mobile app could get you games like "Wolfenstein - The New Order", "Dishonored 2" or "Far Cry 5". No pixelcrap is worth $8. If developers want to get paid the same kind of money as real game developers who know how to do graphics properly, they need to learn how to do graphics properly.

玩法与创新：当战斗变成一场豪赌 游戏最核心的机制是用 “拉霸老虎机” 替代了传统的卡牌出牌。战斗中，玩家主要通过拉动拉杆，根据转轮出现的符号组合来决定本回合的攻防行为（如近战、远程、魔法、防御等）。这种设计常被玩家戏称为“运气模拟器”，因为在很大程度上，生死全看一发入魂。 虽然核心机制依赖运气，但游戏并非完全没有策略深度。它在冒险模式上借鉴了《杀戮尖塔》的爬塔风格（路线选择、节点事件），而在战斗的构筑逻辑上又带有《幸运房东》那种通过搭配道具影响随机结果的影子。玩家可以通过在路途中收集超过120种不同的装备（图标），不断优化和移除行囊中的图标组合，从而在极高的随机性中尝试建立起属于自己的装备联动体系（如叠毒流、法力流等）。 职业与内容体量 游戏目前共提供 4位可玩英雄（如骑士亚拉里克等），每位英雄拥有独特的初始技能和三个阶段的发展方向。例如，初始骑士擅长护甲加成与战斗回血，适合新手开荒；而其他角色则需要完成特定条件（如单次造成300伤害）才能解锁，增加了重复游玩的挑战性。 除了角色，游戏内容包含： · 6种主题关卡 与超过 50种敌人，以及 8个强大的首领 等待挑战。 · 地图为程序化随机生成，每次冒险的路线和遭遇都不同，保证了Rogue-like游戏应有的重复可玩性。 美术风格与视听体验 游戏采用了经典的 像素风格UI 和角色动画。评论认为这种美术不仅控制了游戏的体量，使其看起来精致独特，而且复古的像素绘制配合攻击时的粒子特效（如火系火焰拖尾），营造出了一种轻松且带点幽默感的冒险氛围。 玩家口碑与社区反馈 虽然游戏设计有趣，但从玩家反馈来看，游戏的数值平衡性存在一定争议： · 正向评价：认为游戏上手简单，单局时间短（适合Steam Deck或手机碎片时间游玩），且构筑成型后的爽快感强。可玩性丰富，哪怕通关后仍有“再来一局”的冲动。 · 负面反馈：有玩家指出角色强度差异较大。例如，有评测提到“吸血战士”类角色（依靠续航）比较容易打通高难度，而其他脆皮角色在后期面对高血量BOSS（如7777血）时显得输出乏力，容易因为运气不好而被秒杀。特别是叠甲、荆棘流派在当前版本中前期过渡较难。 版本与购买建议 · 发售信息：游戏最早于 2024年10月8日 在Steam发售，支持Windows及Steam Deck，自带官方简体中文。 · 移动端：后续推出了手机版（Android），适合喜欢触摸屏操作的玩家，但在不同机型上可能存在显示适配问题（后续版本已修复Pixel 10显示）。 · 价格参考：Steam版史低价格约为 19.8元 人民币，作为一款小品级独立游戏，性价比尚可。 总结建议： 《拉杆英雄》 适合那些喜欢 《幸运房东》 或 《杀戮尖塔》 玩法，且不排斥 “赌徒式”随机性 的玩家。如果你享受通过策略微调来对抗糟糕运气，最终利用强力联动瞬间清屏的爽快感，这款像素小品值得一试。但如果你比较看重公平竞技或严谨的数值平衡，可能需要慎重考虑其运气成分占比。

Feels unfinished. The game has glaring balance issues. On top of the fact that the symbol pool is quite modest, a significant part of it practically useless. On the other hand, a few of them are basically auto-win, and they're pretty easy to find by force, due to reroll tokens being overabundant, shop rerolls being really cheap, and a couple other things. There isn't much variety in the builds you can go for, and similarly, enemies basically all act the same. Some of them are more scaling-oriented than the rest, but not enough to ever punish you if you didn't account for it. Some of them will directly target your health with status effects, but you can deal with that very easily, too. And that's it. The game is basically sitting in an awkward spot between solid strategy and simplistic power trip without really achieving either.

[b]Recommended...BUT[/b] ✓** [b]The game is fun[/b], but once you realize it's essentially a Slot Machine Simulator, the RNG can feel either pretty rotten or hugely overpowered. Dealer's choice, honestly. • Characters, along with weapon & stat builds, feel different from each other thanks to variety but it's apparent more time was put into Agility & Magic Debuff builds. • The difficulty spikes can shift suddenly due to the RNG. • The game is rather limited for $8. At $3-5, it's a great deal. Deck-Friendly! [b]Bottom Line:[/b] **Buy it on sale. It's fun, but does feel more like a mobile game without the gimmicks. It isn't conducive to long play sessions; it's meant for bite-sized matches.

If there was a neutral recommendation I would put it here. But in it's current state, it is a very rudimentary gambling roguelite. It has a very low floor and also a low ceiling. The game heavily prioritizes survivalbility and then has a couple of damage check events. There are certain themes that are not fully realized and combining engines and pivioting that are unrelated to survivability does not work very well. There is potential here, but the slots do not work well together. though I do appreciate the enemies somewhat scaling linearly so you do not need an exponential combo build. The replayability is pushed into ascension mechanics which i personally find boring. This game would strongly benefit from the slots having better integration rather than being mostly independent from each other and more slots in general.

别看《拉杆英雄》这款30元的独立“小”游戏那看着简单甚至是有些简陋的页面，但是游戏在玩法机制上还是具有一定的创新性，其类似于老虎机的“轮转机制”，将角色背包中的装备构筑策略和轮转独有的运气值结合起来，有自己的独特之处。不过，目前在数值设计上还是有明显的缺陷，若制作组后续能够不断优化这类问题，游戏的未来发展还是非常大的。
